verdict.rationale: Google's docs clearly cover Google accounts and Google Cloud. They also state the key works on 'other sites that support FIDO CTAP1 standards' and can sign in to 'work and personal services', so cross-service U2F use is claimed generically. A hands-on report confirms it works in Firefox on Linux without Google software, while another user hit a Chrome-only error on a Mac. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of compatibility with GitHub, Microsoft accounts, and password managers, and independent confirmation of FIDO2/WebAuthn coverage beyond CTAP1/U2F.
